title: crataegus brevispina var. microphylla
intro: Crataegus brevispina var. microphylla, commonly known as Chinese Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and aid in digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Hawthorn include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic properties, which contribute to its health-promoting effects. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Hawthorn include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and organic acids, such as oligomeric proanthocyanidin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
